pages.quiz:
GEOGRAPHY — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #16
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: GEOGRAPHY
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Destroying road signs
   B. Littering in markets
   C. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   D. Avoiding all community work

2. Which statement about Vegetation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Vegetation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Vegetation never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Vegetation as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Vegetation.

3. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace the compass rose
   B. Measure rainfall only
   C. Explain symbols used on a map
   D. Name the president

4. Which statement about Mass Wasting is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Mass Wasting never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Mass Wasting.
   C. Treat Mass Wasting as rumours only.
   D. Explain Mass Wasting with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

5. Which statement about Water Cycle and Action of Rivers is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Water Cycle and Action of Rivers with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Water Cycle and Action of Rivers.
   C. Treat Water Cycle and Action of Rivers as rumours only.
   D. Say Water Cycle and Action of Rivers never happens in Kenya.

6. Which statement about Statistical Methods is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Statistical Methods as rumours only.
   B. Explain Statistical Methods with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Statistical Methods.
   D. Say Statistical Methods never happens in Kenya.

7. Which statement about Soils is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Soils never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Soils.
   C. Explain Soils with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Soils as rumours only.

8. Which statement about Elementary Surveying is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Elementary Surveying never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Elementary Surveying.
   C. Treat Elementary Surveying as rumours only.
   D. Explain Elementary Surveying with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

9. Which statement about Weather is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Weather never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Weather.
   C. Treat Weather as rumours only.
   D. Explain Weather with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

10. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nakuru
   B. Mombasa
   C. Nairobi
   D. Kisumu

11. Which statement about Map Reading and Interpretation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Map Reading and Interpretation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Map Reading and Interpretation.
   C. Treat Map Reading and Interpretation as rumours only.
   D. Say Map Reading and Interpretation never happens in Kenya.

12. Which statement about Geographic Information Systems is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Geographic Information Systems.
   B. Say Geographic Information Systems never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Geographic Information Systems with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Geographic Information Systems as rumours only.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Elementary Surveying and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Statistical Methods and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Geographic Information Systems and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Weather and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. C — Obeying laws and caring for public property

2. A — Explain Vegetation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

3. C — Explain symbols used on a map

4. D — Explain Mass Wasting with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

5. A — Explain Water Cycle and Action of Rivers with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

6. B — Explain Statistical Methods with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

7. C — Explain Soils with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

8. D — Explain Elementary Surveying with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

9. D — Explain Weather with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

10. C — Nairobi

11. A — Explain Map Reading and Interpretation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

12. C — Explain Geographic Information Systems with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Elementary Surveying; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Statistical Methods; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Geographic Information Systems; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Weather; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
